### Load libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(readxl)
library(janitor)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
```

### Load data
```{r}
disasters <- read_excel(here("data/americas_natural_disasters.xlsx"))
```

### Explore data
```{r}
#| output: false

# View column names
colnames(disasters)

# Clean names
disasters_clean <- clean_names(disasters)

# View dimensions
dim(disasters_clean)

# View different disaster groups
unique(disasters_clean$disaster_group)

# Filter to just natural disasters
nat_dis <- disasters_clean %>% 
  filter(disaster_group == "Natural")

# View different disaster types and subtypes
unique(nat_dis$disaster_type)

unique(nat_dis$disaster_subtype)

# Add start date and end date columns
nat_dis <- nat_dis %>%
mutate(start_date = make_date(year = nat_dis$start_year,
                   month = nat_dis$start_month,
                   day = nat_dis$start_day),
       end_date = make_date(year = nat_dis$end_year,
                   month = nat_dis$end_month,
                   day = nat_dis$end_day))
```

### Which natural disaster is the most common ?
```{r}
# Create histogram
ggplot(nat_dis, aes(x = fct_infreq(disaster_type), fill = disaster_type)) +
  geom_histogram(stat="count") +
  
  # Flip axis
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_viridis_d() +
  
  # Set titles
  labs(
    y = "Count",
    x = "Disaster Type",
    title = "Disaster Counts in the Americas (2000-2024)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  
  # Remove legend
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

### How do disasters change over time?
```{r}
# Create line plot
ggplot(nat_dis, aes(x = start_year, color = disaster_type)) +
  geom_line(stat = "count") +
  
  # Add titles
  labs(
    title = "Disaster Types over time in the Americas",
    x = "Start Year",
    y = "Count",
    color = "Disaster Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


### Are there patterns between months and disasters?
```{r}
# Create dataframe with counts of natural disasters for each month and year
nat_dis_counts <- nat_dis %>%
  group_by(start_year, start_month) %>%
  summarise(count = n())

# Create timeseries heatmap
ggplot(nat_dis_counts, aes(x = start_month, y = factor(start_year), fill = count)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +  
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", direction = -1, name = "Disaster Count") +
  
  # Set x breaks so theyre integers 1 - 12
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12) +
  
  # Set titles
  labs(title = "Natural Disasters in the Americas per Month (2000-2024)",
       x = "Month", 
       y = "Year") +
  theme_minimal()

```
